title: A paper vocal cord (কাগজের ভোকাল কর্ড)
placement: Book pages 198–199, topic 7.3 শব্দ তরঙ্গ: next to চিত্র ৭.১০ (paper cut and folded into a vocal cord, blown between two fingers) and the নিজে করো at the foot of page 198.
description: A paper vocal cord (pages 198–199, topic 7.3, চিত্র ৭.১০ and its নিজে করো): a strip of ruled exercise-book paper (fibre texture, faint blue rules, real cut edges, a faint glow where light comes through) folded in half and opened like a half-open book, its crease toward the student, its foot gripped in the jaws of a small binder clip on a plain bench, seen close in a gentle three-quarter view from the front and a little above, on a calm blue-grey to warm backdrop. Two flaps are cut at the top of the crease; one big action, ফুঁ দাও: a slim outlined arrow and a few fine streaks of breath go into the open back of the fold, the two flaps open into a V and close like the vocal cords with a dark slit between them and a faint copy at their widest swing (time slowed 100 times and the swing enlarged, said in the panel), and the sound spreads from the slot into the space beside the paper as fine air particles, evenly spread, that bunch into darker-teal compressions (সংকোচন) and thin out into lighter rarefactions (প্রসারণ) travelling outward while each particle only swings in place; one green particle with a mark at its resting place shows it, and an orange bracket spans one λ between two compression centres (drawn shorter, labelled with the real value). A row of words cuts the flaps long, medium or short (14, 10, 7 mm): an honest cantilever model gives about 160, 310 and 640 Hz, so the voice goes from মোটা to তীক্ষ্ণ and λ shrinks (2.06, 1.06, 0.52 m at 330 m/s). Where the panel has room (800 × 500, 1280 × 800) a live pressure–distance graph, 0–4 m, marks a compression, a rarefaction and λ. With sound on, the buzz plays at the real frequency. The rule grows from the vocal cords to source–medium–receiver, to short = high, to the book's sentence on men's and women's voices. Test tab: 5 questions (what vibrates, what one air particle does, a shorter flap, what leaves the slot when the flaps are widest, what the λ mark measures), each wrong choice with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
